CROSS_FILTER.NO_RESULTS: No activity for this filter in the selected period.

DISTRIBUTION.EMPTY_METRIC: Not enough data to compare on this metric.
DISTRIBUTION.HANDLED_SHARE: A conversation handled by two agents counts for both, so the shares can add up to more than 100%.

METRIC_HINTS.RESOLVED_AGENT: Resolutions in the period, credited to whoever was assigned when the conversation was resolved. A conversation reopened and resolved again counts twice.
METRIC_HINTS.RESOLVED: Resolutions in the period. A conversation reopened and resolved again counts twice.
METRIC_HINTS.HANDLED_AGENT: Conversations in which the agent sent at least one public message during the period. Private notes and bot messages do not count.
METRIC_HINTS.HANDLED: Conversations in which an agent sent at least one public message during the period. Private notes and bot messages do not count.
METRIC_HINTS.ASSIGNED_AGENT: Conversations opened in the period that are assigned to the agent today. It does not say who handled them.
METRIC_HINTS.ASSIGNED_TEAM: Conversations opened in the period that are assigned to the team today.
